thread:
Ana (CS): Hey team — Adapt Health requested a three-week enablement series for their migration. Outline: week 1 intro + async prework, week 2 deep-dive + migration clinic, week 3 go-live runbook & smoke tests. They have US/EU/APAC folks; APAC prefers mornings. Can we propose times and facilitators?

Mike (Enablement): I can run weeks 1 and 2 content. Need someone else to lead week 3. For APAC we can do live interpreter + captions on week 2.

Jamie (Product): Do they also want a separate migration clinic for infra/data mapping? If yes, reserve a 90m slot and an engineer.

Luis (Adapt - PM): Yes, separate clinic. Infra lead needs a Q/A window. APAC prefers 09:00–11:00 SGT, EU prefers afternoons CET, US mornings PT. Avoid weeks 33-34 (sprint freeze).

Sam (CS Ops): Draft schedule (local windows):
Week 1 — Onboard & prework review (60m)
  US: Wed 10:00 PT / EU: Wed 18:00 CET / APAC: Thu 09:00 SGT (recorded)
Week 2 — Deep-dive + migration clinic (120m; 60/60)
  US: Tue 10:00 PT / EU: Tue 18:00 CET / APAC: Wed 09:00 SGT (interpreter)
Week 3 — Go-live runbook + smoke tests (90m)
  US: Thu 09:00 PT / EU: Thu 17:00 CET / APAC: Fri 09:30 SGT
I will create calendar placeholders with timezone-specific links.

Ana (CS): Ops asks: 1) Need one engineer for clinic (Jamie?), 2) 1-pager prework checklist to send. I'll draft both.

Jamie (Product): I can staff the clinic and prep infra hooks doc. I'll also join week 3 for smoke-test checklist.

Mike (Enablement): I'll build the slide deck and hands-on lab. If we don't have an interpreter vendor, I can request our translation partner.

Ana (CS): @Luis can you confirm attendees and whether to invite security reviewer to week 3? Any blackout dates?

Luis (Adapt - PM): Attendees: product, infra lead, security reviewer (tentative), two devs. No blackout dates next 6 weeks aside from sprint freeze weeks 33-34. Security prefers a separate 30m sync if required.

Sam (CS Ops): Actions:
- Ana: prework checklist + repo with prework/ samples (EOD Wed)
- Mike: deck + lab exercises (next Tue)
- Jamie: engineer prep + infra hooks doc (next Tue)
- Sam: calendar invites (with Interpreter: TBD)
- Luis: confirm final attendee list and security sync requirement (Fri)

scheduler-bot: Poll created — https://doodle.example/Adapt-Enablement (please add availability)

Ana (CS): Keep lab exercises short: max 30m per attendee. I'll create the shared repo and link in invites. :party_parrot: 

Mike (Enablement): @Sam please book a 60m internal dry-run the day before week 2.

Sam (CS Ops): Booking now — I'll post calendar.

Ana (CS): I'll post invite links and the prework doc once live. Closing loop: majority of deliverables due next Tue, prework EOD Wed. :white_check_mark:
